players.product: proprietary single-molecule tracking (SMT) platform with AI/ML-guided drug discovery

quarterly_data.signal: Platform slides in the Q3 company update deck (8-K Exhibit 99.1, August 2026): Eikon's technology platform is centered around proprietary single-molecule tracking (SMT), which captures the real-time dynamics of individual proteins at scale; in the WRN-inhibitor (EIK1005) section, Eikon SMT revealed WRN trapping and degradation upon inhibition, findings that led to elucidation of key contributors to the WRN inhibitor-driven degradation mechanism. Machine learning and computational chemistry (AI/ML plus physics-based models and protein-ligand docking) guide Eikon's androgen receptor (AR) antagonist designs; the local ML models developed for AR show R2 of 0.77 for Caco-2 permeability, 0.86 for Chrom LogD, 0.87 for EPSA, 0.61 for AR SMT antagonist and 0.64 for AR SMT agonist. EIK1006 was declared a clinical candidate in November 2025 and its preclinical studies are now tracking ahead of schedule.
quarterly_data.figure: local AR ML models R2 0.77 (Caco-2 permeability), 0.86 (Chrom LogD), 0.87 (EPSA), 0.61 (AR SMT antagonist), 0.64 (AR SMT agonist); EIK1006 declared clinical candidate November 2025

quarterly_data.signal: Milestone plan in the Q3 company update deck: for EIK1001, after the first interim analysis to choose the dose for the melanoma study, a second interim analysis to proceed to Phase 3 for the melanoma study is planned for 1H2027; the FDA has allowed Eikon to proceed with the Phase 2/3 registrational trial in NSCLC; the TeLuRide-005, TeLuRide-006 and TeLuRide-008 trials were initiated in Q1 2024, Q2 2025 and Q1 2026. For EIK1004, completion of Phase 1/2 dose escalation is planned for 2H 2026. Eikon is also actively pursuing additional discovery research in oncology and neurodegeneration.
quarterly_data.figure: second interim analysis to proceed to Phase 3 (melanoma) 1H2027; EIK1004 dose escalation completion 2H 2026
